SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.role_id, u.status
     FROM public.users u
     WHERE LOWER(TRIM(u.email)) = $1
        OR TRIM(u.phone) = $2
        OR TRIM(u.phone) = $3
        OR ($4 <> '' AND LENGTH($4) >= 10 AND RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = RIGHT($4, 10))
     LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (admin_name, action, target, details)
           VALUES ('CCTV_WORKER', 'AUTO_STOP_RECORDING', $1, $2);

UPDATE public.games
         SET status = 'ONGOING'
         WHERE status IN ('OPEN_FOR_JOINING', 'FULL')
           AND match_date <= CURRENT_DATE
           AND start_time <= CURRENT_TIME
           AND end_time > CURRENT_TIME
         RETURNING id;

SELECT g.id, g.creator_id, g.title, g.entry_fee, g.match_date, g.start_time
       FROM public.games g
       WHERE g.approval_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND g.status <> 'CANCELLED'
         AND (g.match_date + g.start_time) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
       FOR UPDATE OF g SKIP LOCKED;

UPDATE public.games
         SET status = 'CANCELLED',
             approval_status = 'REJECTED',
             rejection_reason = 'Auto-cancelled: Game was not approved by manager before scheduled start time',
             cancellation_reason = 'Auto-cancelled: Game was not approved by manager before scheduled start time',
             updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
         WHERE id = $1;

SELECT gp.user_id, COALESCE(g.entry_fee, 0) as refund_amount
         FROM public.game_players gp
         JOIN public.games g ON g.id = gp.game_id
         WHERE gp.game_id = $1 AND gp.payment_status = 'PAID';

INSERT INTO public.wallets (user_id, balance)
             VALUES ($1, $2)
             ON CONFLICT (user_id)
             DO UPDATE SET balance = public.wallets.balance + $2, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

SELECT g.id, g.club_id, g.court_id, g.title, g.match_date, g.start_time, g.end_time
       FROM public.games g
       WHERE g.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
         AND g.status IN ('OPEN_FOR_JOINING', 'FULL')
         AND (g.match_date + g.start_time) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
         AND (g.match_date + g.end_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
       FOR UPDATE OF g SKIP LOCKED;

SELECT id, is_enabled FROM public.cctv_cameras
           WHERE (court_id = $1 OR club_id = $2 OR court_id IS NULL)
             AND is_enabled = true
           ORDER BY (CASE WHEN court_id = $1 THEN 0 WHEN club_id = $2 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)

SELECT g.id, g.club_id, g.court_id, g.title, g.match_date, g.end_time
       FROM public.games g

UPDATE public.cctv_recordings
         SET recording_status = 'POST_MATCH',
             stop_deadline = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + ($2 || ' minutes')::interval,
             post_match_stop_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + ($2 || ' minutes')::interval
         WHERE game_id = $1 AND (status = 'RECORDING' OR recording_status = 'RECORDING');

SELECT rec.id, rec.game_id
       FROM public.cctv_recordings rec
       WHERE (rec.status = 'RECORDING' OR rec.recording_status IN ('RECORDING', 'POST_MATCH'))
         AND (
           rec.stop_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
           OR rec.post_match_stop_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
         )
       FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;

SELECT id FROM public.users
       WHERE LOWER(TRIM(email)) = $1

              cam.connection_type, cam.ip_address, cam.port, cam.serial_number,

SELECT crt.*, clb.name as club_name, clb.city FROM public.courts crt JOIN public.clubs clb ON clb.id = crt.club_id WHERE crt.status = 'AVAILABLE';

SELECT user_id FROM public.club_managers WHERE club_id = $1;

SELECT g.*, c.name as club_name, c.address as club_address, c.city, crt.name as court_name,
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id) as current_players_count
      FROM public.games g
      LEFT JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id = g.club_id
      LEFT JOIN public.courts crt ON crt.id = g.court_id
      ${whereClause}
      ORDER BY g.match_date ASC, g.start_time ASC
      LIMIT $${idx++} OFFSET $${idx++};

SELECT g.*, c.name as club_name, crt.name as court_name,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id) as current_players_count,
              COALESCE(
                (SELECT gv.video_url FROM public.game_videos gv WHERE gv.game_id = g.id AND gv.status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY gv.created_at ASC LIMIT 1),
                g.video_playback_url
              ) as video_playback_url,
              (
                SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(
                  json_build_object(
                    'userId', gp.user_id,
                    'user_id', gp.user_id,
                    'name', COALESCE(pu.name, 'Player'),
                    'profileImageUrl', pu.profile_image_url,
                    'profile_image_url', pu.profile_image_url,
                    'team', UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(gp.team::text, ''), 'TEAM_A')),
                    'position', COALESCE(gp.position, 'MID'),
                    'ovr', COALESCE(pd.ovr_rating, 80),
                    'paymentStatus', COALESCE(gp.payment_status, 'PAID'),
                    'payment_status', COALESCE(gp.payment_status, 'PAID'),
                    'phone', pu.phone
                  )
                  ORDER BY gp.team ASC, gp.joined_at ASC
                ), '[]'::json)
                FROM public.game_players gp
                JOIN public.users pu ON pu.id = gp.user_id
                LEFT JOIN public.player_details pd ON pd.user_id = gp.user_id
                WHERE gp.game_id = g.id
              ) as roster
       FROM public.games g
       LEFT JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id = g.club_id
       LEFT JOIN public.courts crt ON crt.id = g.court_id
       WHERE g.id = $1;

         AND ((start_time <= $3 AND end_time > $3)
           OR (start_time < $4 AND end_time >= $4)

DELETE FROM public.game_waitlist
       WHERE id = (
         SELECT id FROM public.game_waitlist
         WHERE game_id = $1
         ORDER BY joined_at ASC LIMIT 1
       )
       RETURNING *;

SELECT gv.*,
              gv.cctv_id,
              COALESCE(cam.name, 'Camera ' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY gv.game_id ORDER BY gv.created_at ASC)) as camera_name,
              COALESCE(cam.camera_type, 'RTSP_DOME') as camera_type,
              COALESCE(cam.status, 'ONLINE') as camera_status,
              COALESCE(crt.name, 'Court 1') as court_name,
              COALESCE(clb.name, 'All Stars Turf') as club_name,
              COALESCE(rec.started_at, rec.created_at, gv.created_at) as started_at,
              COALESCE(rec.actual_stopped_at, rec.actual_stop_time, gv.created_at) as actual_stopped_at,
              COALESCE(rec.duration_seconds, 5400) as duration_seconds
       FROM public.game_videos gv
       LEFT JOIN public.cctv_cameras cam ON cam.id = gv.cctv_id
       LEFT JOIN public.courts crt ON crt.id = COALESCE(gv.court_id, cam.court_id)
       LEFT JOIN public.clubs clb ON clb.id = gv.club_id
       LEFT JOIN public.cctv_recordings rec ON (rec.game_id = gv.game_id AND (rec.camera_id = gv.cctv_id OR gv.cctv_id IS NULL))
       WHERE gv.game_id = $1 AND gv.status = 'AVAILABLE'

              COALESCE(
                (SELECT gv.video_url FROM public.game_videos gv WHERE gv.game_id = g.id AND gv.status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY gv.created_at ASC LIMIT 1),
                g.video_playback_url
              ) as video_playback_url,
              CASE WHEN g.court_id = 'court_2' THEN 'Court 2' ELSE 'Court 1' END as court_name,
              c.name as club_name,
              gp.team as my_team, gp.position as my_position,
              CASE
                WHEN UPPER(g.status::text) NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FINISHED') THEN 'PENDING'
                WHEN g.winner_team = 'DRAW' THEN 'DRAW'
                WHEN (gp.team = 'TEAM_A' AND g.winner_team = 'TEAM_A') OR (gp.team = 'TEAM_B' AND g.winner_team = 'TEAM_B') THEN 'WIN'
                ELSE 'LOSS'
              END as result,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.game_players gp_cnt WHERE gp_cnt.game_id = g.id) as current_players_count,
              (
                SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(
                  json_build_object(
                    'userId', gp_r.user_id,
                    'user_id', gp_r.user_id,
                    'name', COALESCE(pu.name, 'Player'),
                    'profileImageUrl', pu.profile_image_url,
                    'profile_image_url', pu.profile_image_url,
                    'team', UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(gp_r.team::text, ''), 'TEAM_A')),
                    'position', COALESCE(gp_r.position, 'MID'),
                    'ovr', COALESCE(pd.ovr_rating, 80),
                    'paymentStatus', COALESCE(gp_r.payment_status, 'PAID'),
                    'payment_status', COALESCE(gp_r.payment_status, 'PAID'),
                    'phone', pu.phone
                  )
                  ORDER BY gp_r.team ASC, gp_r.joined_at ASC
                ), '[]'::json)
                FROM public.game_players gp_r
                JOIN public.users pu ON pu.id = gp_r.user_id
                LEFT JOIN public.player_details pd ON pd.user_id = gp_r.user_id
                WHERE gp_r.game_id = g.id
              ) as roster
